spans.s:
m. (-मः)
1 A city, a town.
2 A wharf, a landing place.
f. (-मा)
1 A name of the goddess PĀRVATĪ or

Flax, (Linum utilatissimum.)
6 Quiet, tranquillity.
E.
उ particle of calling, and मा prohibition: i. e. “Practise not austerities,” the exclamation addressed to DURGĀ by her mother: in the other senses it may be derived from मा to measure, or मा lustre.

Reproach, abuse.
4 Arrogance.
n. (-मं)
A city.
E.
अव to preserve, &c. मन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-टः)
The cluster of flax.
E.
उमा flax, कच् aff.

m. (-रुः)
The mountain Himālaya.
E.
उमा the goddess, and गुरु a spiritual teacher: in mythology the personified mountain is the father of UMĀ.

m. (-तिः)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
उमा and पति master; the husband of UMĀ.

n. (-नं)
A name of Vanapura or Devī Koṭa, (Devi Cote.)
E.
उमा and वन a grove; the residence of UMĀ.

m. (-तः)
A name of KĀRTTIKEYA.
E.
उमा and सुत a son, the son of PĀRVATĪ.
